scientific_limitations: The result concerns real 2x2 Hurwitz drift with distinct real prescribed eigenvalues, identity invariant covariance and strictly positive noise covariance. It does not cover arbitrary covariance condition numbers under whitening, high dimension, or singular-noise boundary entropy production. Generic two-dimensional OU Lyapunov/entropy-production identities in earlier literature may imply parts of the classification; earlier unpublished specialization remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact inverse-spectrum dissipation and anisotropy frontier for planar Ornstein–Uhlenbeck steady states
